feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: VHS Vibes 1.3.0
entry.summary: A worn video-tape effect: pitch wobble, saturation, generation loss, hum, hiss and crackle, plus deck faults (level control, drift, tracking drop-outs) and a dry/wet mix. 21 programs, on a hot pink cassette with reels that turn.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.1.2
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: Maze Voice 2.0.0
entry.summary: Monophonic Moog Labyrinth-style thru-zero oscillator, wavefolder and state-variable filter voice with two LFOs, a page randomiser and a three-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: Maze Sequencer 2.0.0
entry.summary: Dual 8-step generative sequencer (Moog Labyrinth style) with corrupt, scale quantising, two LFOs and per-line MIDI channels, driving other tracks over MIDI.

entry.title: CTRL MixBus 2.2.0
entry.summary: CTRL Mixbus is a professional stereo mixing and processing effect designed to streamline your workflow across three focused pages. Take control of input gain, stereo width, equalization, precision filtering, dynamic gating, and loudness maximization.

entry.title: Cadenza 0.28.1
entry.summary: Chord-driven generative MIDI sequencer: pick a key and scale, shape chords, bass and melody with a few knobs per page, and it generates and follows along as you play.

entry.title: πRemote 0.1.0
entry.summary: Compact Windows transport and physical-button navigation companion for the official Remote Screen, on Force OS 3.10.1. Independent addin; localhost only, reached through an SSH tunnel. Windows app requires WSL Ubuntu and SSH key access.

entry.title: Xenia 1.0.2
entry.summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: ten touchscreen pages, ROM banks and patch browser, assignable play knobs and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.

entry.title: Xenia 1.0.1
entry.summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: ten touchscreen pages, ROM banks and patch browser, assignable play knobs and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.

entry.summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: ten touchscreen pages, ROM banks and patch browser, assignable play knobs and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.

entry.title: VADER 0.10.1 (beta)
entry.summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (15 built in, 35 maths shapes, or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG or JPG) or one of 27 modes across four corners. Each corner plays overtone generators, one of 14 voices, or a WAV sample. Two timbres, arpeggiator, effects. Its screen runs on your phone: scan the QR code, load shapes from the phone too.

entry.title: Tuney 1.4.4
entry.summary: Real-time vocal pitch correction: key and scale or your own notes on a touch keyboard, a pitch dial, Retune, Transition, Amount, Vibrato and Humanize, voice ranges and a reference pitch. Presets from hard tune to subtle.

entry.title: Tropix 0.1.5
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion, from redistributable recordings and original synthesis. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways.

entry.title: Tributary 1.2.4
entry.summary: Sums chosen Elektron Overbridge outputs onto one MPC track over USB. The machine is 48 kHz; the track resamples that to the MPC's 44.1. Capture saves the machine's own 48 kHz samples, locked to the bars. Based on Overwitch.

entry.title: Stompbox 1.1.1
entry.summary: A whole guitar rig from guitarix's DSP: gate, comp, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet with an IR loader, post FX, mod, delay, reverb and EQ. 219 models and guitarix's 40 factory presets in the PRESET menu. Not affiliated with guitarix.

entry.title: Sonix 0.3.15
entry.summary: A melodic ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, built as a native ARM VST2 plugin. Includes pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and effects, using redistributable sound libraries.

entry.title: Shapey EQ 1.6.3
entry.summary: An 8-band parametric EQ you shape by touch: tap or drag on the curve, drag numbered dots, and make any band a bell, shelf, cut, notch or band pass. Live analyzer, zero latency, presets and four themes.

entry.title: Shapey 5-Band EQ 1.0.2
entry.summary: The 5-band version of Shapey EQ, made for touch: every band has its own lane under a taller curve, so any dot drags directly. Any band can be a bell, shelf, cut, notch or band pass. Live analyzer, zero latency.

entry.title: Profit-5 2.0.0
entry.summary: Five-voice analog polysynth modelled on an early SSM-chip classic: two oscillators, a four-pole resonant filter, Poly-Mod, wheel-mod, glide and unison, 38 factory programs, a Rev 2 / Rev 4 voicing switch, and an importer for Repro-5 .h2p patches.

entry.title: Profit-08 2.0.1
entry.summary: Eight-voice, two-layer analog-style synthesizer: stack and split layers, a gated sequencer and arpeggiator, a resonant 2/4-pole filter, and a banks browser with favourites for your own program and bank SysEx dumps. 2.0 adds a native MPC screen with large knobs and Q-Link control of every page.

entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.5
entry.summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, sung doos, flutes, reeds, brass, atmospheric strings, bells, Juno-style synths, wind and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, delay, reverb and sub. 96 presets; a CRT crystal-ball orb reacts as you play. Gen1 (MPC OS 3.x, plus an OS 2.x zip) and Gen2.

entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.9
entry.summary: Odin 2 synthesizer ported to standalone Akai MPC devices as a native VST2 plugin. Features Odin's original engine, 261 factory patches, touchscreen pages, automatic voice management and a CPU meter. Tested on an Akai MPC Live II; unofficial port.

entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.8
entry.summary: OB-Xd, the Oberheim OB-X emulation: two oscillators with sync and cross-mod, a 12/24 dB filter, voice variation; 128 presets.

entry.title: Nova Editor 0.7.1
entry.summary: An editor and librarian for the Novation MiniNova as a native plugin, with its own MPC screen skin: every control maps to a MiniNova CC/NRPN, controls follow the synth, banks A-C and imported .syx files live on the SD card. Also a SysEx librarian for any other synth. With nova-audio loaded, the MiniNova plays on the plugin's own track.

entry.title: NAM 1.1.0
entry.summary: Neural Amp Modeler captures as an insert effect, with cab IR, tone, gate, pitch, delay, reverb and an on-device TONE3000 downloader.

entry.title: MPC USB audio 1.2.1
entry.summary: The MPC as a USB audio interface: its outputs and inputs as channels on the computer, next to its MIDI ports. Works where the device port is wired to the USB-B socket (Key 37 verified; One, One+). Not on the Force, Live II or X: their USB-B port sits behind the internal hub in standalone mode; use force-link-audio there.

entry.title: MPC Remote 1.4.1
entry.summary: The MPC screen in a browser, and an MCP server so an AI model can see and touch it, play MIDI and read files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: MPC Gateway 1.0.2
entry.summary: One HTTPS address and one login (mpc / mpc until you change it on its Settings page) for every addin's web page. A start page lists the services addins declare (ADDIN_WEB_PORT), each routed behind the password. Runs Caddy beside MPC. Device only by default (reach it through an SSH tunnel); bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network.

entry.title: MPC File Browser 1.1.1
entry.summary: FileBrowser Quantum beside MPC: browse the device's drives in a web browser, upload and download samples and projects, play audio, edit text files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (login admin / mpcadmin; change it). bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network.

entry.title: MPC Commander 1.3.1
entry.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, on a desktop app. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: MonoSlide 1.0.5
entry.summary: Monophonic acid bass voice with overlapping-note slide, velocity accents and an MPC touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Mini-JV 2.0.1
entry.summary: An emulation of the Roland JV-880 sample-based sound engine as a native instrument, with the original reverb and chorus, a Play page with eight macros and a touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Liminal Hz 1.4.1
entry.summary: Real rooms, halls and echoes from impulse responses (up to 5 s, mono or stereo), the space for your NAM amp; ~3.5% of an audio block on a Force; browses reverbs/ folders and TONE3000.

entry.title: Liminal Amp 1.1.0
entry.summary: Lightweight, official-sound Neural Amp Modeler: A2 captures with cab IR, gate and tone stack, resampled like the official plugin; browses models/ and irs/ folders on any drive. One MPC OS 3.10.1 folder for every MPC.

entry.title: JC303 0.2.3
entry.summary: 303-style monophonic acid synth for Gen2 MPCs, with native Q-Links, a 16-step sequencer, 37 neural drive models and MPC presets. Hardware tested on Live III.

entry.title: HexChord 73 1.0.3
entry.summary: Stereo chord synthesizer with four engines, eight chords, four voicings and a touchscreen chord diagram.

entry.title: HexChord 73 1.0.2
entry.summary: Stereo chord synthesizer with four engines, eight chords, four voicings and a touchscreen chord diagram.

entry.title: Fretty 0.8.6
entry.summary: A guitar instrument for Akai MPC OS standalone devices (native VST2), featuring refined selector typography, 110 presets, and a synth layer.

entry.title: Dexed 2.0.3
entry.summary: DX7-style 6-operator FM synth (Dexed/MSFA engine) as a native instrument, with .syx bank browsing, all 32 algorithm diagrams and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: πMorpH 0.1.2
entry.summary: Polyphonic XY wavetable synthesizer with paths, orbit, dual envelopes, HP/LP filters, two LFOs and an eight-slot modulation matrix. Includes 100 presets plus INIT and Custom Wavetable import: mono/stereo PCM16, PCM32 or float32 WAV, 512/1024/2048 samples per waveform.

entry.title: Tuner 1.1.1
entry.summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.
